projects.title: Responsive relationship reconstruction
projects.completeScope: Complete one/two/four grid tracks at explicit breakpoints, flexible header/card relationships and 16:9 media in the supplied card fixture.
requiredEvidence: Screenshot or text excerpt identifying own observation

projects.title: Intrinsic sizing and readable content
projects.completeScope: Repair shrinkability and wrap an unbroken identifier without concealing overflow or truncating the fixture.
requiredEvidence: Relevant min-width and overflow-wrap computed styles

projects.title: Keyboard focus and motion preference
projects.completeScope: Add visible keyboard focus and disable transitions under reduced-motion preference.
requiredEvidence: Actual reduced-motion emulation and computed transition

limitation: All three projects require genuine learner browser measurements. The checker supports the stated teaching syntax only; equivalent CSS needs teacher review. A static PASS is not native-browser acceptance.
minute_fields_scope: projects[].minutes retains the historic supplied source budget; it is not the current candidate schedule or a measured completion time.

candidate_planning.shorter_slot_policy: Arrange an explicit taught continuation; retain all required projects and evidence. A minute table does not prove novice feasibility.
